system.longDesc: You’re skilled in restraining and subduing opponents in unarmed combat.

degree0.desc: If you fail an opposed Fighting (Grappling) test to avoid being grappled, as per the Grapple stunt’s description in Chapter 5, you can re-roll it but must keep the results of the second roll.

degree1.desc: If you successfully hit an opponent with an unarmed attack and choose a stunt from the grappling category, you gain 1 additional SP to apply.

degree2.desc: You can perform the Pin stunt for 3 SP instead of the usual 4. In addition, your penalty to Defense when using the Grapple and Pin stunts is halved.
